Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.frontend.utilityfrontend

Interface FractalHandler

public interface FractalHandler
Interface representing a handler for fractal interactions such as zooming and panning. This interface provides methods to handle zoom and pan actions, which can be implemented by classes that need to respond to these interactions.
Since:
0.0.3 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)
